vo.text: If you're on a legacy CRM, you know how it goes.
It's expensive, and the price goes up every year.
On top of that, your reps spend hours every week typing in notes and updating deals by hand.
That's time they should be spending with customers.
There has to be a better way.
That's why we built Omniscient. It's a CRM that updates itself.
Start by telling Scout who you want to sell to. It finds people on LinkedIn who match, and shows you why they're worth reaching out to right now.
Otto, our AI agent, writes the first message. You check it and hit approve.
When someone replies, it shows up in one inbox, right next to everything you know about them.
After a call, Omniscient reads the transcript and updates the deal for you, from the stage to the next step.
Click any field to see exactly where it came from.
Your team doesn't have to type a thing.
When it's time to close, Otto builds a private page for the deal, with the plan and pricing your buyer needs.
Your buyer picks the number of seats and approves it right there.
Omniscient takes you from the first message to a signed deal, all in one place. And AI is included in the price.
Try it free at try omniscient dot com.
